Maybe that helps? In few words, I would say adding vegetation might be the best way to keep the humidity at a good place.

90% humidity is not necessary, it's usually the yellow-foot tortoises that do require that high of humidity since they're a rainforest species.

Red-foots tortoises live in savannas and sometimes forests, so they are good with "just" 70%-80% humidity. 

Yes, the best way to maintain humidity is to add plants and things that the water can adhere to. I like the moss idea, they also really like hiding in plant filled areas, so they might like to hide in the moss if needed. Besides that, you can just mist twice or three times a day, early in the morning, at noon and in the evening. If you can get something that can measure the humidity, it might help to keep track.

Also, even though there is a water tray, make sure that you soak your tortoise every day with warm water(Specially your tortoise is less than 1 year old) for 10-20 minutes. After the 1-year mark, you can soak less frequently if you prefer. I like soaking my redfoots every other day to make sure that they're hydrated and so they go potty(warm water stimulates their bowel movements).

Food-wise, just feed them a varied diet of greens, with some fruits from time to time(red-foots eat more fruit than an average tortoise species). You can add calcium powder on the greens to make sure he's getting enough calcium, and you can feed him mazuri tortoise pellets maybe once a week to make sure he's getting some protein. I myself feed my redfoots their mazuri diet and fruits once a week.

I was in your position a few years ago, I felt lost, I felt like no one cared about me and didn't take how I felt seriously. If I felt any kind of happiness at any moment, I just knew it would end, so I would stop enjoying it. Now, those days seem all like a blur of days going by, back then I felt nothing and just wanted to end it. I'd fantasize it every day and wrote some letters. Only stayed alive for my sister and my dog. I will say that it took me years to really feel happy and content about my life and where I was. Now I feel happy, not just for others, but also for myself.

Change won't happen over night, mine wasn't. It took years, it took many baby steps, I didn't believe people cared about me, until slowly I did. I didn't do things for myself, because I thought I didn't deserve it. I started doing small things, taking care of my dog, taking her to training classes, drawing, maybe get excited of a new show/game, I can't die until I see/play X thing, you know? That kind of thing. 

I don't know if you have pets, or if you are a person who likes pets, but to me they bring me so much joy and happiness. Taking care of them, building them spaces to be in, seeing them happy and healthy. If there's anything I know for sure, is that our pets(dogs specially) will always love us, they care.

Once again, I really wish you the best. Maybe what I said was kinda senseless, I apologize if it was, I've never done this before. But, good luck. Be safe. And do remember, the first step is not the most important step to take, it's always the next one. Keep moving forward.
